(a) galaxy clustering measurements can simultaneously constrain cosmological and bias parameters, and (b) the combination of galaxy redshift clustering and weak lensing measurements can provide a powerful probe of cosmological parameters and the galaxy HOD.

the HOD can be determined to high precision, and the cosmological parameters can be determined to a precision that is comparable to the precision of HOD.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the HOD can be constrained to a high degree of precision, even if the underlying cosmology differs from the fiducial one.

galaxy clustering measurements can be used to break the degeneracy between cosmological parameters and HOD, and that this can be done in a way that is complementary to the standard approach of constraining cosmology using large-scale structure.
